products.name: Celia
products.description: Celia likes to spend time in her treehouse, where she has a beautiful tea set and soft cushions for her friends to sit upon. Sometimes the birds of the forest fly through the window, and she gives them tea and biscuit crumbs.

products.name: Ezra
products.description: Ezra wonders how his backyard would look to him if he were a frog. Would Frog Ezra like to sit amid the grass or the clover more? Would the mud be cool and clean? Would he be afraid of Ezra's dog, Sparky? There's a lot to think about.

products.name: Jules
products.description: Jules wants to tell you about his new kitten, Chuckles, who he really loves. He keeps her warm in her basket, pets her soft head, and plays with her so she gets enough exercise.

products.name: Louise
products.description: Whenever she has a moment to spare, she scampers to the forest glade beyond her house. There, she can look for her friends, the forest creatures, and read them stories from her library books.

products.name: Sadie
products.description: Sadie has been using her sharp scissors to make lovely paper cuttings. All her favorite flowers, and portraits of her friends and their pets, and illuminated letters. She tapes these onto her bedroom window and enjoys the way the afternoon sun shines through them.

products.name: Arthur Lamb
products.description: In the meadow full of tasty green grass, Arthur Lamb shares his toys and plays nicely with his friends Lucas and Puffy: kites, tag, and Baa-Ball. He snacks on grass and bonbons whenever he gets hungry.

products.name: Flora Fox
products.description: This fox girl loves only one thing more than ballet. It is whittling. She makes salad bowls and forks for her salad-eating friends, and often carves props for the animals' plays in their theater.

products.name: Gracie Cat
products.description: If you ask Gracie what her favorite activity is, she will tell you: fishing. She has loved it ever since she was a kitten. She says on a good afternoon, she can catch a dozen minnows. When she has enough she takes her fish to Flora Fox's house, and the animals have a fish fry. Although some of them eat only salad. Gracie says that is fine; more fish for her.

products.name: Max Raccoon
products.description: Max has a hollow tree behind his house. He has installed numerous shelves and cubbyholes inside it, and there he keeps cool things that he finds: bits of crockery that he makes into wind chimes, good paper bags he's saving, presents from his friends, jars of pickles and jam, etc.

products.name: Zoe Rabbit
products.description: Zoe Rabbit is converting part of the stream bank into a rock garden. It's slimy work, she says, but somebody's got to do it. Possibly. She's building minnow pools into the lower levels, and a terrace higher up. Yesterday she saw two beautiful orange newts.

products.name: Carrot Cardigan
products.description: An orangey-red cardigan knit from a blend of baby alpaca and merino wool, with three working HV corozo buttons. The texture reminds Arthur Lamb of tasty carrots lined up in neat rows.

products.name: Cinnamon Scarf
products.description: When the weather turns chilly and the leaves turn crisp, it's important to bundle up! This dark red scarf is knit from merino wool yarn with cotton tassels on the ends.

products.name: Dancing Boots
products.description: Flora Fox wears these splendid booties for dance performances in his secret tree house. They are also well suited for everyday wear around the village. Made from dark brown leather and white cotton canvas, with a decorative brogue detail on the toe. Waxed cotton laces.

products.name: Flowery Dress
products.description: This roomy smock dress is just the thing to toss on for some early-morning foraging. It looks splendid worn on its own or layered over a pair of pants for extra warmth in cold weather. Made from woven cotton in a lovely soft blue, scattered with sprigs of berries and leafy branches. Velcro back closure.

products.name: Hazelnut Pants
products.description: Dark brown corduroy pants have big side pockets, fully functional of course, for the treasures your dolls or animals find on the go: little notes their friends wrote them; stickers for later; good feathers and rocks. Velcro back closure with an overlap for your animal's tail to stick out. Très chic wide-leg silhouette. These pants perfectly match the Hazelnut Tailcoat, for a truly dapper head-to-toe corduroy look.

products.name: Leafy Overalls
products.description: Deep green linen overalls with short legs, velcro back closure, and an overlap in the back where an animal's tail can stick out. There is a handy pocket on the bib to hold what Zoe Rabbit calls the niceties. She said niceties are if you find trinkets or snacks that you think are nice, and you want to keep them close.

products.name: Ruffled Skirt
products.description: In our opinion, this is just about the loveliest skirt you could have! It has three ruffled tiers of white eyelet cotton embroidered with flowers, and the waistband is our custom brocade ribbon. Fully lined, with velcro back closure.

products.name: Sky Shirt
products.description: A classic Village shirt with a delightful waffle-weave texture. White and blue woven checks give the effect of wispy clouds drifting across the sky. Two patch pockets for carrying your cloud-gazing snacks, or perhaps a little sketchbook to draw the shapes you see. Fastens with two real shell buttons.

products.name: Strawberry Bag
products.description: The woodland friends highly recommend carrying your belongings around in a giant strawberry. Not a real strawberry, of course, that would be messy. This bag is made from wool felt and embellished with hand-embroidered strawberry seeds. Its leafy lid fastens with a snap, so you needn't worry about anything falling out. The cross-body strap is a twisted cotton cord in tones of pink, yellow, and green, with accent tassels on the ends.

products.name: Turnip Sweater
products.description: The comfiest turnip sweater there ever was! Made from a soft and stretchy cotton jacquard, custom-knitted for us by a textile manufacturer in Germany. Golden-brown woven cotton collar with velcro back closure.
